data.long_meaning: In Sanskrit, Mithu means 'sweet' or 'love'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'mithu', which also refers to a 'friend' or 'companion'. In Hindu mythology, Mithu is the name of a goddess, representing the sweetness and love in relationships. The name Mithu carries the meaning “Sweet, Love” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mithu usually hope their child will grow to embody sweet, love and live with faith, good character and purpose.

It connotes harmony, love, and friendship, reflecting the values of sweetness and companionship deeply embedded in Indian culture. Mithu is also a popular name for heroines in Indian cinema, symbolizing the gentle, loving, and caring nature of women in our society.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, Mithu is a divine embodiment of love and compassion. As a goddess, she represents the sweetest and most nurturing aspects of femininity. Mithu is the benevolent goddess who protects and cares for her devotees, providing them with comfort, peace, and happiness.
